description: After a compressed confirmation act, the formation question (Q4) accumulates one finding per sitting across seven weeks of gapped work. The scenario pins down promotion timing: Q4 must live as a note or stub through F26 and F31, earn its full section exactly in the F32-F34 window, and never balloon the outline. A mid-arc instruction to emphasize the weak age story (F21/F22) tests the salience floor: conversion to stub plus plan, not prose inflation.

events.expect: Both age findings (F21, F22) are weak: the emphasis converts at the evidence floor into a stub/charge for the age sub-story plus planned corroboration items — no prose inflation, no promotion of weak claims into the lead (RECORD_DESIGN 14.4).

assertions.expect: After F26 and F31 the formation direction holds at most a stub or note under Q4 — one kinematics finding and one context finding do not yet earn a full section.
The Q4 formation direction is promoted from stub to a full section exactly once, within this window (as F32-F34 land), not before event 33 and not after event 41.

The age-emphasis instruction converts at the evidence floor: an age-story stub/charge plus planned corroboration items appear under Q2; the prose around the weak F21/F22 is not inflated and neither claim is promoted to lead position.
Outline depth is at most 3 throughout; no section holds fewer than 2 findings except intent-born or floor-converted stubs.
F35 supersedes F32's face-value CE-default reading with visible provenance: the revised formation story cites both, and F33/F34 remain cited as evidence against the CE channel — nothing is deleted.
The planned item compiled by the plan gesture on F26 is taken up and reaches produced/absorbed as the formation analyses (F32-F35) land; it is not left dangling at the final distill.
Every Class-2 structural change across the long gaps has a matching ratification or a visible expiry; the Q4 section promotion (Class 3) carries explicit consent.
